blocks.text: These Turkish-program options trade a lower points quote in reported economy for reported business class and a shorter overall journey. Both also depend on a separate SFO–LAX ticket; repositioning permission and the consequences of separate tickets are unconfirmed, and the positioning-fare scopes are unknown.
At 110,000 Turkish-program points, this is the lower points quote of the two.
